visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: No Wrap-Around at the End of the Alphabet
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Shifting xyz by 3 should give abc, but the program prints the symbols {|}.

solution.explanation: Adding the shift to a letter near the end of the alphabet goes past 'z' into other characters. The % 26 brings the offset back into the range 0 to 25 so the alphabet wraps around.
